rationale: ConsoleCLI subclasses stdlib cmd.Cmd and in-repo code drives cmd.Cmd.cmdloop; typing 'help diff' makes cmd.Cmd.do_help call getattr(self, 'help_' + arg)(), so help_diff is a real framework hook reached by naming convention. The computed-name dispatch lives in the stdlib, not in repo source, and no in-scope rule targets cmd.Cmd do_/help_ conventions, so fp-novel is the best fit; dynamic-property-keyed-callback's obj[name]() description is arguably close enough to be defensible.
prior_verdicts_assessment: The single fp-novel verdict is correct and identifies the getattr-based do_help dispatch accurately.
